name: movie-service
description: Домашний веб-кинотеатр для Smart TV с управлением со смартфона

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @movie/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @movie/server" "npm run dev -w @movie/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @movie/server && npm run build -w @movie/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,web "npm run start -w @movie/server" "npm run start -w @movie/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @movie/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @movie/shared && npm run test -w @movie/server
